- FedEx changed its fiscal year end from May 31 to December 31 effective for the period beginning June 1, 2026, so the June-through-December 2026 period is a transition year and the company's forward guidance is given for calendar year 2026 rather than for a fiscal Q1 FY2027. [1]
- FedEx reported total revenue of $25,007 million on a GAAP basis for Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended May 31, 2026), compared with $22,220 million in Q4 FY2025 (quarter ended May 31, 2025), a 13% increase as disclosed. [1]
- Calculated on the reported figures, Q4 FY2026 total revenue grew 12.5% year over year versus Q4 FY2025. [1]
- On a GAAP basis, Q4 FY2026 operating income was $1.55 billion with a 6.2% operating margin, versus $1.79 billion and 8.1% in Q4 FY2025; adjusted (non-GAAP) operating income was $2.09 billion at an 8.4% margin, versus $2.02 billion at 9.1% a year earlier. [1]
- On a GAAP basis, Q4 FY2026 net income was $1.60 billion and diluted EPS was $6.60, versus $1.65 billion and $6.88 in Q4 FY2025; adjusted (non-GAAP) net income was $1.53 billion and adjusted diluted EPS was $6.31, versus $1.46 billion and $6.07 a year earlier. [1]
- For full-year fiscal 2026 (twelve months ended May 31, 2026), FedEx reported GAAP revenue of $94,720 million, up 8% from $87,926 million in fiscal 2025, with GAAP operating income of $5,463 million (5.8% margin), net income of $4,433 million and diluted EPS of $18.55. [1][3][4]
- FedEx's outlook (guidance) for calendar year 2026 is revenue growth of approximately 11% year over year, with the baseline being calendar 2025 preliminary recasted results from continuing operations that reflect FedEx Freight as discontinued operations. [1]
- FedEx's calendar year 2026 guidance is for diluted EPS from continuing operations of $16.55 to $17.75 on a GAAP basis and $16.90 to $18.10 on an adjusted (non-GAAP) basis, with an effective tax rate of approximately 23%. [1]
- The spin-off of FedEx Freight into a separate publicly traded company was completed on June 1, 2026, and FedEx Freight paid a cash dividend of approximately $4.1 billion to FedEx Corporation in connection with the spin-off. [1]
